name: Langoustine
siboNotes: Plain langoustines are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Avoid breaded preparations or high-FODMAP seasonings.
preparationTips: Choose fresh or frozen plain langoustines without added seasonings
Avoid breaded or battered preparations which may contain wheat
Cook simply with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Remove shells completely as they can be difficult to digest
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like parsley or chives
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of selenium and vitamin B12
